**Issue #4285 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4285: Patch: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes IV
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

The designer's **Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes IV**: one keyword rule, a de-keywording of the Starship Pieces, and number, text and stat changes on about 25 cards. Every card ID and current value below was read from `crates/cards/catalog.json` on `main` (2026-11-20). Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` first (CLAUDE.md rule 10). Where the designer's wording leaves a choice, this issue gives a reading as **Reading:**; build that reading, and record it in a ruling note when the spec does not already make the call (CLAUDE.md rule 3).

#### 1. Flashback (keyword rule, §6.1 table, §6.3 Play)

You must spend at least (1) to cast a card from your graveyard by Flashback.

- Today a Flashback play costs the card's own cost (`spec/06-keywords.md` Flashback row, R783012, R783013, R3039001, R3138000 for embiggen). After this patch the price, as it would be paid after every discount, never goes below (1). An embiggen card's two prices each get the floor.
- **Reading:** the floor applies to every Flashback, printed or lent (S #152 Sanctum's and C #28 Second Wind's Auras lend the keyword, R1869003). It does not apply to other graveyard plays (C #74 Corpse Plantation's permission, a printed `graveyardPrice`, R3560001). Second Wind's old face already had a floor of at least (1) (`spec/08-catalog.md` row C #28, "balance patch 1"), so look there for a precedent.
- Update the §6.1 Flashback row, the §6.3 Play paragraph, and wherever legal actions and the client show the price.

#### 2. The Great De-Keywordification

- **Remove Equip from every Starship Piece.** Every card that prints both Starship Piece and Equip loses Equip on both faces and keeps Starship Piece. There are 52 on `main`:
  - Stinkyscape: #38 Shield Amplifier, #48 Ultralight Chassis, #50–#61 (Beam / Repeater / Cannon / Flak v3–v5), #62–#66 Miner v1–v5, #67 Tractor Beam, #98 Hull Booster, #100 AP Rounds, #101 Overdrive Module, #104 Reflective Plating, #122 Vamp Rounds, #136 Magic Module, #140–#143 (Rush Token / Fruit / Jade / Book Launcher), #175 Frost Module, #177 Cloaking Module.
  - Stinkyscape+: #8–#10 Drone Assembler v3–v5, #11 Energy Booster, #12 Shield Booster, #13 Shield Repairer, #14 Hull Repairer, #15 Hull Repairer mk2, #16 Servo Surge, #19 Normalization Module, #143–#145 Fire Beam v3–v5, #146–#148 Scourge Mortar v3–v5, #149–#153 (Flaming / Scorching / Volcanic / Venomous / Noxious Rounds).
  - Re-run the census when you build, in case `main` has moved.
  - Also drop Equip where a card *grants* it with Starship Piece: S #129 Jlockeed's Missile Pod's Embiggened line (below) and S+ #39 Mindustrial Cross-over (below). Grep the scripts for any other grant.
- **Must keep working:** "Equip from a pick" (`equip_picks`, R1841002) is how S #79 Orca, S #82 Phalanx and S #83 Halo fuse Miners and Weapons into themselves. Those pools are these same pieces. Check whether the pool, or the AI, filters on the Equip keyword. If it does, change it so these cards still work, and add a test that each one still fuses its pick after this patch. Rod of Ages' `lendsEquip` (S #16, R1869000) is not affected.
- Update the §6.1 Starship Piece and Equip rows, and the §8 rows that say "Starship Piece, Equip".
- **S+ #106 Spectre** (`stinkyscapeplus-106`): remove Flexible from both faces (base 3/12, Radiant 6/24, other keywords kept).
- **M #39.5 Jade Beauty** (`meditative-039-5`, token): replace Indestructible and Immutable with Evasive on both faces. Base becomes "Can't attack, Evasive"; Radiant becomes "Evasive". The rest of its text is unchanged.

#### 3. Card changes

| Card (id) | Now | After |
|---|---|---|
| Hull Repairer (`stinkyscapeplus-014`) | 0/2, Radiant 0/4 | **1/4**, Radiant **2/8** (and loses Equip, §2) |
| Hull Repairer mk2 (`stinkyscapeplus-015`) | 0/4, Radiant 0/8 | **1/4**, Radiant **2/8** (and loses Equip) |
| Jlockeed's Missile Pod (`stinkyscape-129`; the designer wrote "Missile Pods") | 1/1, Radiant 2/2; cost 1, embiggen 2; "End of turn: Deal damage equal to its Attack divided by {divisor} (4, Radiant 3), rounded up, to all enemies. Embiggened (2): Starship Piece and Equip." | **2/2**, Radiant **4/4**; embiggen **(3)**. Base: "End of turn: Deal damage equal to its Attack split among all enemies.\nEmbiggened (3): Starship Piece." Radiant: "End of turn: Deal damage equal to twice its Attack split among all enemies.\nEmbiggened (3): Starship Piece." The `divisor` param is retired. **Reading:** "split among" follows Hearthstone (Avenging Wrath): the damage goes one point at a time, each to a random living enemy (enemy Units and the enemy hero), drawn through the match `Rng`. Use the engine's existing split verb (`crates/engine/src/effects/split.rs`; S #137.3 Air Doctrine and TG #33 Guerilla Felinor use it) and state whether the hero is included the way that verb already does. Attack is read when the hook fires. |
| Mindustrial Cross-over (`stinkyscapeplus-039`) | "…Give it Starship Piece and Equip." | "…Give it Starship Piece." (both faces) |
| Shield Booster (`stinkyscapeplus-012`) | Starship Piece, Equip, Divine Shield | Starship Piece, Divine Shield, **Armor 1** (Radiant **Armor 2**) |
| A Glimpse into the Endless Sea (`stinkyscapeplus-079`) | `count` 8 (both faces) | `count` **7** (both faces) |
| Siva 2 (`stinkyscape-088`) | 4/4, Radiant 8/8 | **5/4**, Radiant **10/8** |
| True Conservative (`stinkyscapeplus-033`) | 3/3, Radiant 6/6 | **4/4**, Radiant **8/8** |
| Crawler Swarm (`stinkyscapeplus-135`) | cost 3 | cost **4** |
| Volcanic Rounds (`stinkyscapeplus-151`) | 3/1, Radiant 6/2 | **5/1**, Radiant **10/2** (and loses Equip) |
| Memory Leak (`classicplus-034`) | Crater on both faces | loses Crater (both faces) |
| Mend Projector (`stinkyscapeplus-041`) | cost 2 | cost **1** |
| Wildar (`stinkyscape-149`) | Opponent's Call to Chaos costs (0); Radiant: yours costs (0) too | The opponent's Call to Chaos costs **(1)**. Radiant: your Radiant Call to Chaos costs **(1)**. **Reading:** the opponent's card costs (1) on both faces. |
| Profe Yates (`stinkyscapeplus-004`) | 7/7, "…Then summon two random Traps."; Radiant 14/14, "…three random Radiant Traps." | **6/6**, "…Then summon **a random Trap**."; Radiant **12/12**, "…three random Traps." (no longer Radiant) |
| Orca (`stinkyscape-079`) | 3/3, Radiant 6/6 | **3/1**, Radiant **6/2** |
| Arc (`stinkyscapeplus-038`) | 0/5, Radiant 0/10 | **0/4**, Radiant **0/8** |
| Phalanx (`stinkyscape-082`) | 3/3, Radiant 6/6 | **3/1**, Radiant **6/2** |
| ZolarKeth (`stinkyscape-026`) | 2/7, Radiant 4/14 | **2/5**, Radiant **4/10** |
| Halo (`stinkyscape-083`) | 2/2, "Cry: Choose one of 2 Rare Weapons and Equip it into this, 3 times." (Radiant 4/4, Epic) | **3/1**, Radiant **6/1**. Base: "Cry: Discover a Rare Weapon and Equip it into this, twice." Radiant: the same with an Epic Weapon. `weapons` 3 → 2. **Reading:** a standard Discover (§6), made once, and the one pick is equipped twice, as Orca's Radiant "Equip it into this, twice" works. |
| Quad (`stinkyscapeplus-122`) | `heal` 6, Radiant 12; Radiant has Armor 2 | `heal` **3**, Radiant **6**; Radiant loses Armor 2 |
| Call to Chaos (Meditative Edition) (`meditative-095`) | see below | see below |
| The House (`classicplus-007`) | `tokens` 3 | `tokens` **2** (both faces) |
| Black Hole (`stinkyscapeplus-077`) | base closes after `permanents` 10 | base closes after **7**; Radiant unchanged (it never closes) |
| Buff Billy (`classicplus-069`) | "This is a 2X/3X", Radiant "4X/6X" | "This is a **2X/2X**", Radiant "**4X/4X**"; the Cry is unchanged |
| Horizon Breaker (`stinkyscapeplus-156`) | 3/6, Radiant 6/12 | **4/6**, Radiant **8/12** |
| Tatches the Totem (`meditative-087`) | "While this is in your hand or deck: After you play a card with a tribal tag, summon this." | No longer summons itself from your hand. **Reading:** taken literally, it becomes "While this is in your deck: After you play a card with a tribal tag, summon this." on both faces, so it still summons itself from the deck. If the designer meant both zones, they will correct it on the pull request. |

**Call to Chaos (Meditative Edition).** The designer's instruction: *"Find a way to nerf what you think out of line modes are by ~20%."* This is your design call. Pick the modes that are out of line, using data where you have it: the AI gate's and the stats tools' per-card numbers, with any win rate quoted from `cargo jackioh stats compare` (`docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Win rates in a balance patch). Weaken each one you pick by about 20%, e.g. 2 cards → fewer or not free, 4 Armor / heal 4 → 3, and leave the rest alone. Both faces list the same modes. Write the modes you picked and why in the pull request and in the patch fragment's `notes`.

#### Spec and patch bookkeeping

- Change each card's `spec/08-catalog.md` row (and `spec/07-tokens.md` for Jade Beauty), plus `catalog.json`, scripts and params, in the same pull request. Every old behavior stays foldable, as `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` says for a shipped card (the `script_v…` kept-version pattern, R767000).
- One pending fragment: `cargo jackioh patches "Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes IV" --source "#<this issue>" --notes "…" --rule`, with its player note written by hand (`balance` lines "from … to …", `changes` for the keyword and text changes).
- New ruling notes go in this issue's R-block, with proving tests (the Flashback floor, the Missile Pod split, Halo's single Discover equipped twice, Tatches' deck-only summon, and Equip-from-a-pick still working on de-keyworded pieces), each paragraph in `spec/pending/<N>.md`.

### Acceptance

- [ ] A card played from its graveyard by Flashback, printed or lent by Sanctum or Second Wind, costs at least (1) after discounts. A (0)-cost Flashback card costs (1) from the graveyard and still (0) from hand. An embiggen Flashback card's two prices are each at least (1). A non-Flashback graveyard play (Corpse Plantation, `graveyardPrice`) is unchanged.
- [ ] No card in `catalog.json` prints both Starship Piece and Equip, and no script grants Equip together with Starship Piece. Each de-keyworded piece still fuses into the Dormant Starship on death.
- [ ] Orca, Phalanx and Halo still fuse their Miner or Weapon picks into themselves (one test each).
- [ ] Spectre has no Flexible. Jade Beauty has Evasive and neither Indestructible nor Immutable, on both faces.
- [ ] Every stat, cost and param in the table matches `catalog.json` and each card's script tests on both faces (CLAUDE.md rule 6).
- [ ] Jlockeed's Missile Pod deals its Attack (Radiant: twice its Attack) at end of turn, split one point at a time among random enemies, through the match `Rng`. Its Embiggened (3) gives Starship Piece only.
- [ ] Mindustrial Cross-over gives Starship Piece and no Equip. Shield Booster has Armor 1 (Radiant Armor 2).
- [ ] Wildar's Call to Chaos for the opponent costs (1), and its Radiant face's own Radiant Call to Chaos costs (1). Profe Yates summons one random Trap, or three non-Radiant Traps on its Radiant face.
- [ ] Halo Discovers once and equips the pick twice. Quad heals 3 (Radiant 6), and its Radiant face has no Armor. The House places 2 Plague Counters. The base Black Hole closes after 7. Buff Billy is 2X/2X (Radiant 4X/4X). Tatches the Totem never summons itself from your hand, and still does from your deck.
- [ ] Call to Chaos (Meditative Edition): the modes chosen are each about 20% weaker, as named in the fragment's notes.
- [ ] Every older version still folds: `cargo jackioh golden check` passes, and every shipped replay that played these cards replays unchanged.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `names --check` and `classify --base origin/main --claims` pass, and so do `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` and `cargo jackioh gate`.

### Blocked by, part of

None. The planner may split this into parts (`Patch (part n of m): …`) if it judges one pull request too large, e.g. the Flashback rule, the de-keywording, and the number changes.
```
